summary: Head Out place autocomplete (OSM-backed) + live 'blue dot' map. Backend: 12/12 pass (new test_geo_autocomplete_osm_live.py plus the existing test_head_out_places_autocomplete.py). The connaught call returns provider 'osm' with status 200, both with and without the lat/lng bias; details round-trip and validation also pass. Frontend (375px web preview, Playwright with mocked geolocation): typed autocomplete, loading row, empty-result message, Clear, dropdown above the map, selecting a suggestion (field, pin, circle and map centre all update), Search button, radius 100/300/Custom, map tap, pin drag, timer start and 'I'm home safely' all PASS. Live map with permission granted: the dot and accuracy ring appear and MOVE when the mocked position changes, the map first centres on the user, and Recenter works after a pan. Denied: the explanation dialog shows first, then a calm fallback line, and the rest of the page keeps working. CRITICAL bug found and fixed by tester: leaving Head Out with location granted crashed the whole app (RootErrorBoundary 'Dhara needs to restart'). After the fix, watchers stay balanced over 3 navigations (no leak). Still open: the Enter key does not show manual-search results; stale autocomplete responses reopen the dropdown after Clear or Enter; the bookmark button is clipped off-screen at 375px.

minor.issue: _fallback_cache is an unbounded module-level dict with a TTL that is checked on read but never evicted, so memory grows with every distinct query+bias key. Add a max size or LRU. Also, 'now' is taken before waiting on the lock, so cached entries are timestamped slightly early (harmless).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (FIXED by tester): navigating away from /women/head-out while the watcher was active threw 'TypeError: _LocationEventEmitter.LocationEventEmitter.removeSubscription is not a function' from expo-location 19 LocationSubscribers.unregisterCallback. The whole app fell into RootErrorBoundary ('Dhara needs to restart'). Cause: on web, LegacyEventEmitter returns the new-style web module, which has no removeSubscription. Fix applied: try/catch around subRef.current?.remove(). This is safe because removeWatchAsync (navigator clearWatch) runs before the throwing line; the clearWatch counter confirms the watch is cleared. The same unguarded pattern exists in src/hooks/useJourneyGPS.ts:134 (GO1B, currently off; not touched).

Pressing Enter sends GET /api/geocode/search (200, with results), but dp-suggestions never appears. RCA: a single-line RN-web TextInput blurs on submit (blurOnSubmit defaults to true). The onBlur handler (DestinationPicker.tsx:773) then runs setShowSuggestions(false) 150 ms later, hiding the results. After Enter, document.activeElement was null. The Search button works (6 rows). Fix: add submitBehavior='submit' / blurOnSubmit={false} on dp-destination-input, or set suppressBlurHideRef.current=true inside submitSearch.

(1) Type 'bandra west', then tap Clear about 350 ms later: the in-flight autocomplete response reopens dp-places-suggestions ('Bandra West | Mumbai...') while the field is empty. (2) Type 'red fort' and press Enter at once: the pending debounce or in-flight response reopens the places dropdown over the manual search. Cause: handleLabelChange('' or <3 chars) and submitSearch clear neither the pending timeout nor placesReqRef. Fix: in both paths, clearTimeout(placesDebounceRef.current) and ++placesReqRef.current.

With text in the field, the row holds the input plus 3 buttons (44 px each, gap 8). dp-save-place (bookmark) sits at x=353–397 inside a 375 px viewport with 20 px side padding, so it is clipped off-screen and effectively cannot be tapped. Fix: give the input minWidth:0 and/or shrink the buttons, or place the clear 'x' inside the input.

issues: With permission granted and no destination yet, the map centres on the user, but the destination pin and radius circle stay at the Delhi demo point (28.6139, 77.209), off-screen. The hint still says 'Click the map or drag the pin', but no pin is visible. Consider placing the initial pin at the live position (without setting value), or hiding the pin until one is chosen.

The dialog has a single 'OK' button that always triggers the browser/OS permission request. There is no 'Not now' option, even though the copy says 'You can carry on without it'. Add a secondary 'Not now' button that only closes the dialog.
The manual OSM search is not location-biased: 'India Gate' returns Paris, Vienna, Warsaw and Lisbon rows. This is minor and pre-existing; consider passing countrycodes=in or the bias.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-location 19.0.8 on web throws on LocationSubscription.remove() when the last watcher is removed. Guarded in src/women/useLivePosition.ts:34 (tester fix). Still unguarded in src/hooks/useJourneyGPS.ts:134. Reference: node_modules/expo-location/build/LocationSubscribers.js:50
DestinationMapPicker.tsx:171 showsUserLocation={!!userLocation} is UNTESTED: native only, cannot be verified in web preview.

action_items: Review and keep the tester's try/catch in useLivePosition.stop(). Apply the same guard to src/hooks/useJourneyGPS.ts:134 so the same crash cannot happen if GO1B is turned on.

Fix the Enter key: dp-destination-input blurs on submit and onBlur hides dp-suggestions. Add submitBehavior='submit' (or blurOnSubmit={false}), or set suppressBlurHideRef.current = true at the start of submitSearch.
Cancel the places debounce and in-flight request on Clear, on text shorter than 3 characters, and on submitSearch: clearTimeout(placesDebounceRef.current) and ++placesReqRef.current.
Fix the input-row overflow at 375px so dp-save-place is fully visible and tappable when text is present.
Optional: when first-centring on the user with no pin set, move the visible pin or circle to the live point (or hide it). Add a 'Not now' button to the location explanation dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: useLivePosition.startWatching has an unmount race: if the component unmounts while 'await Location.watchPositionAsync' is still pending, the subscription is assigned after stop() has already run and is never removed (leaked watcher). Fix: after the await, if (!aliveRef.current) { try{sub.remove()}catch{}; return; }
The AppState listener's stop() runs on web visibility changes; it is now guarded by the try/catch, but before that it would have thrown inside the event handler.
DestinationPicker.tsx is 1177 lines, above the 700-line guideline. Split out the modals, the autocomplete hook and the live-position controls.
Bias handling is correct: lat/lng are sent only when the live point exists (permission granted). This was checked in network requests; no bias params are sent in the denied context.

rca_of_issue: Navigation crash: on web, expo-location's LegacyEventEmitter(ExpoLocation) returns the web module itself because __expo_module_name__ is set, and that module has no removeSubscription. LocationSubscriber.unregisterCallback calls it after removeWatchAsync, so LocationSubscription.remove() throws during the React unmount effect and hits RootErrorBoundary. Repro: grant geolocation, open Head Out, navigate back. Mitigation applied: try/catch in stop(). Enter key: RN-web blurs on submit, and the onBlur timeout hides the suggestions.
